cohort: 39,977 mothers in the Danish National Birth Cohort
finding: Vaginal birth was associated with a higher risk of long-term urinary incontinence, but shortening the second stage of labor may reduce this risk.
mod_finding: Compared with women with only spontaneous births, a history of only caesarean sections was associated with much lower odds of urinary incontinence, and a history of instrumental births with slightly lower odds.
